coordinate_convention: Zero-based original source pixels. Integer polygon vertices use inclusive Pillow polygon rasterization; each field is a union of polygons.
purpose: Source-supported clothing and prop exclusions, and visible hair support for all 162 child non-S/idle frames: 18 accepted child looks, nine poses each. Proposals require downstream original-source comparison; no numeric gate or owner approval is claimed.
limitations: Coarse pixel boundaries remain approximate. Exclusions include visible garment trim, calf/ankle wraps and held props.
Hair envelopes describe visible hair only; hidden hair or anatomy is not reconstructed.
Skin supports are optional and omitted where uncertain. No polygon alone labels every enclosed pixel.
Sleeping sources are 112x80 landscape; standing sources are 80x112. Coordinates are always original-image coordinates, never rotated.
